title: All And Only Chests
description: Minecraft but you can only get items through generated chests in structures. Gather them all to complete the challenge.
body:
# All And Only Chests
All And Only Chests is a Minecraft challenge mod where the world stops giving you free resources.

No block drops.
No normal mob drops.
No fishing loot.
No easy item farming.

Your only real source of items is loot from generated structure chests.

The goal is simple, but brutal: choose a structure, explore the world, open its chests, and collect as many unique items from that structure as possible. Every structure has its own progress counter, so you can switch between them and continue where you left off.

Can you complete every structure only through chest loot?

## Can You Still Beat Minecraft?
Yes.

Most mob drops are disabled, but Blazes have a 1% chance to drop a Blaze Rod, so completing the game is still possible. You can still reach the End, but getting there becomes a real challenge instead of a routine grind.


![A first-person view in Minecraft shows a grassy field under a bright blue sky with scattered block-shaped clouds. The player has empty hands and a full health bar, and a timer on the screen says “1h 2m 13s.” In the top-right corner, there is a challenge progress box labeled “end city 0/55.”](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5e4598b128ba2d7030fd4d6501ce0cc628fe344e.png)

## Features
- Blocks drop nothing when broken
- Mobs drop nothing, except Blazes
- Blazes have a 1% chance to drop a Blaze Rod
- Fishing loot is disabled
- Structure chest loot is the main progression source
- Inventory-style structure selection menu
- Per-structure progress tracking
- Progress saves when leaving the world/server
- HUD counter showing current structure progress
- Built-in challenge timer
- Custom timer colors
- Supports switching between structures without losing progress
## Commands

```
/allchests menu
```

Opens the structure selection menu.


```
/allchests target <structure>
```

Sets the active structure manually.


```
/allchests progress
```

Shows your current structure progress.


```
/allchests reset
```

Resets your All And Only Chests progress.


```
/allchests timer start
```

Starts or resumes the timer.


```
/allchests timer pause true
```

Pauses the timer.


```
/allchests timer pause false
```

Unpauses the timer.


```
/allchests timer seconds <seconds>
```

Sets the timer to a specific amount of seconds.


```
/allchests timer hms <hours> <minutes> <seconds>
```

Sets the timer using hours, minutes, and seconds.


```
/allchests timer full <years> <months> <weeks> <days> <hours> <minutes> <seconds>
```

Sets the timer using a full time format.


```
/allchests timer color <startHex> <endHex>
```

Changes the animated timer color gradient.
